proposed.explanation: Part 1 addresses quality standards and testing requirements, not application procedures. Part 2 specifies the product (epoxy resin type, color, specification). Curing and application procedures are not administrative matters. This is Part 3: Execution content. It specifies application procedure (two coats, dry film thickness), installation conditions (temperature), and curing time. These are installation and quality control procedures. Application sequences, coating thickness, curing conditions, and installation procedures belong in Part 3. If you're describing how to do the work, it's Part 3.
